The '''wife''' of [[Sander Delvardus]] was an heiress of the prestigious [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Despite her status, Delvardus was a womanizer, and was in love with his mistress, [[Seledra-Zin]].
